## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      5 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 8 авг. 2026 г. - 22 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _valb663_, 22 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "zero customer service. wrongfully suspended my trial after 1 day after a studio cancelled on me. worst experience i have ever had and i couldn’t even contact a person to help. Will never be using this platform again, to think i was going to join a monthly plan. Horrible company really."
            2. _yogaforever191_, 19 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I like the concept of classpass and the app is solid. I ended up disliking it because the packages would say "12-22 classes" and would really only get you about 5. Classes are a lot of credits and their estimates are wildly off. Feels deceiving and ends up being more expensive than going through the studio. They need to change their messaging or decrease the cost."
            3. _C.W.2026_, 16 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I’ve used ClassPass consistently and used to genuinely love it. I currently pay $49/month for 23 credits, and there were times when I could take 3–4 classes per week because many of the classes I regularly attended were only 2–4 credits. That has changed drastically. Classes at my regular yoga studio that I historically booked for 2–4 credits are now regularly 4+ credits, and I recently saw a Buti Yoga class listed for 10 credits. That ONE class would use almost half of my entire monthly allowance. ClassPass says pricing fluctuates based on demand, but I’ve attended higher-credit classes that were nowhere near full, which makes the pricing feel arbitrary and incredibly difficult to plan around. What makes this even more frustrating is that the solution ClassPass continually pushes is upgrading to a more expensive plan. But paying more money for additional credits doesn’t solve the underlying problem when the number of credits required per class keeps increasing too. I shouldn’t have to continually increase my monthly spending just to maintain roughly the same fitness routine my existing plan previously allowed. I loved ClassPass because it made fitness more accessible and gave me flexibility. Now the unpredictable credit inflation is actively interfering with the routine I built using the service. Unless the credit system becomes more reasonable and transparent, I’m seriously considering canceling altogether."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 14 мар. 2026 г. - 17 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _mattallsop_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I have reported the issue to my bank. This app should be reviewed by Apple for breach of app store rules on billing."
            2. _kgk_kcc_, 13 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Can’t get anything fixed now that customer service went to AI. Good luck if you have any issues with your account, billing, etc. Awful experience"
            3. _MoRoNe93ahshsh_, 6 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "The 14 day trial is just a straight up lie. As soon as you sign up for it you see that you can’t actually book anything with it- it even shows classes available to you specifically with the trial membership and when you try to book it says you have to upgrade. Also the app itself is soooo awful and buggy- nothing works."
<!--/ir-theme-->
